import json,math,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from benchmark_tools.prepare_ob_candidate_neighborhood import record,check
from benchmark_tools.run_membership_hillclimb import PRODUCTS,write_json
from benchmark_tools.compare_qfo_scored_pairs import read_scores,compare
from benchmark_tools.diagnose_hillclimb_pair_confidence import read_confidence,summarize
repo=Path.cwd();base=repo/"benchmark_tools/results"
table_path=base/"hillclimb_comparison_readback_v10_20261013/summary.json"
table=json.loads(table_path.read_text())
control=next(c for m in table["methods"] if m["key"]=="copy_branch:control" for c in m["cells"] if c["dataset"]=="QfO")
admit_path=repo/"benchmarks/results/component_recovery_admission_r1_v1_20261013/report.json"
variant=json.loads(admit_path.read_text())
if variant["status"]!="terminal_component_candidates_and_raw_scores_independently_verified": raise ValueError("Component functional diagnostic has no admitted native result")
out=base/"large_copy_components_functional_diagnostic_20261013.json"
if out.exists(): raise ValueError("Preserve existing diagnostic")
folders=[repo/"benchmarks/results/deferred_qfo_inferred_r1_v2_20261013/control/qfo_scoring",repo/"benchmarks/results/component_scoring_recovery_r1_v1_20261013/qfo_scoring"]
cells=[control,variant];evidence=[record(table_path),record(admit_path),record(base.parent/"hillclimb_component_functional_diagnostic_20261013.json")]
values={};raw_summaries=[]
for metric in ("GO","EC"):
 values[metric]=[]
 for cell,folder in zip(cells,folders):
  paths=list((folder/"results"/metric).glob("*raw.txt.gz"))
  if len(paths)!=1: raise ValueError("Ambiguous retained functional raw output")
  pin=record(paths[0]);evidence.append(pin);raw=read_scores(paths[0],metric)
  expected=cell["scores"]["QfO: "+metric]
  raw_mean=sum(raw.values())/(len(raw)*1e6)
  if len(raw)!=cell["details"][metric]["assessed_relations"] or abs(raw_mean-expected)>5.051e-7: raise ValueError("Raw eligible-pair count or serialized mean differs from admitted endpoint")
  values[metric].append(raw)
  raw_summaries.append({"metric":metric,"cell":"control" if cell is control else "components500","raw":pin,"pairs":len(raw),"raw_mean":raw_mean,"admitted_mean":expected})
confidences=[];counts=[]
for i,cell in enumerate(cells):
 pin=cell["products"][PRODUCTS[2]];check(pin);evidence.append(pin)
 watched=set().union(*(set(v[i]) for v in values.values()))
 found,classes=read_confidence(Path(pin["path"]),watched,cell["coverage"]["pairs"])
 confidences.append(found);counts.append(classes)
comparisons={}
for metric,rows in values.items():
 overlap=compare(*rows)
 if overlap["shared_pairs_with_different_serialized_scores"]: raise ValueError("Shared serialized functional annotation score changed")
 buckets=summarize(*rows,*confidences)
 comparisons[metric]={"overlap":overlap,"confidence_buckets":buckets}
for pin in evidence: check(pin)
sources=[record(repo/"benchmark_tools"/name) for name in ("compare_qfo_scored_pairs.py","diagnose_hillclimb_pair_confidence.py","run_membership_hillclimb.py","prepare_ob_candidate_neighborhood.py")]
write_json(out,{"status":"admitted_component_functional_pair_changes_descriptively_localized","evidence":evidence,"sources":sources,"raw_summaries":raw_summaries,"native_confidence_counts":counts,"comparisons":comparisons,"scope":"Serialized eligible annotated pair composition and native evidence labels; arithmetic only, not causal attribution, orthology truth, calibrated confidence or uncertainty.","native_inference_rerun":False,"new_scoring":False,"uncertainty_admitted":False,"defaults_promoted":False,"goal_completed":False})
print(json.dumps({"raw_summaries":raw_summaries,"comparisons":comparisons}))
